results: 1. nerve conduction studies / EMG: rhythmic bursts in both hands, synchronised with the visible jerks
2. EEG: no abnormality, and no EEG-EMG correlation on video-EEG - the myoclonus is subcortical
3. somatosensory evoked potentials: NO giant SSEP - argues against a cortical origin
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-infectious subcortical myoclonus associated with recent SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) infection

Alternative 1: Functional (psychogenic) myoclonus

Alternative 2: Epileptic cortical myoclonus

Alternative 3: Toxic-metabolic or medication-induced myoclonus
dx: Post-infectious subcortical myoclonus associated with recent SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) infection
